description: This file defines metrics and recording mechanisms for pod security admission evaluations in Kubernetes, including Prometheus metrics counters, labels, and related logic.

classes.name: PrometheusRecorder
classes.description: Implements the Recorder interface, recording metrics for pod security evaluations using Prometheus counters.

methods.name: NewPrometheusRecorder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new PrometheusRecorder with counters for evaluations, exemptions, and errors.

methods.name: MustRegister
methods.description: Registers the recorder's metrics with the provided registration function.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets all counters in the recorder.

methods.name: RecordEvaluation
methods.description: Records a policy evaluation decision with associated attributes and versioning info.

methods.name: RecordExemption
methods.description: Records an exemption event with specific attributes.

methods.name: RecordError
methods.description: Records an error event, indicating if it was fatal.
